step_basis: frame index of per-action observations, not video playback seconds or model completion time
step_provenance: scripts/build_crossing_annotation.py: steps and rendered frames are one-to-one
scripts/replay_crossing_checkpoint.py: executed action index uses observation.frame
streaming_protocol: Five independent case processes consume existing sampled nodes in order. Each new candidate is compared with the last established active node; wait for response and commit the update before taking the next candidate. No re-sampling, artificial time delays, or precomputed comparison batch.
source_candidates: node_elimination/v002_run01/manifest.json (raw sampled nodes only; elimination decisions ignored)
